decisions.reason: It fits the firm's growing compliance focus and agency customer base and remained on its own page in 2024, but as a somewhat more adjacent software tool than core hosting services it carries a modestly higher drop risk.
This platform sits at the center of the firm's existing infrastructure, tooling, and know-how, and its continued home-page prominence signals strong learning, strategic fit, and commercial relevance.

A configurable managed hosting plan is very close to the firm's established capabilities and customer needs, and its continued dedicated presentation suggests the firm can refine and absorb market feedback effectively.

Extended PHP security support builds directly on the firm's technical service teams and security promise, so despite being newer and less prominently evidenced it is still a strong fit with the firm's absorptive capacity and strategy.
